description: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring contradictions.logic.json (the same four validation items and the sources-exist prerequisite repeat in all 6 entries). Shape of data/logic_rules.json entries.

entries.name: Catalog — every id in a list resolves
entries.description: True when every id in `ids` names an existing catalog entry (its active data is not null). json-logic's `all` is false for an empty list, so the empty case is allowed explicitly. Used as the sources-exist prerequisite and sources-resolve validation in all contradiction entries; the same shape is inlined for rules' cross_refs (rules.shared.json cross_refs_resolve).

entries.name: Contradiction — sources and resolutions present
entries.description: A contradiction proposal names at least one source entry and proposes at least one resolution. Inlined as sources-non-empty / resolutions-proposed in all 6 entries. Context {proposal}.

entries.name: Contradiction — chosen resolution is one of the proposed
entries.description: chosen_resolution is absent (open vote) or equals the resolution_id of one of proposed_resolutions. Inlined as chosen-is-proposed in all 6 entries. Context {proposal}.

entries.name: Contradiction — a resolved entry keeps its choice
entries.description: Once a contradiction is resolved its chosen_resolution is history: a new version keeps it. Inlined as resolution-kept in the 4 resolved entries. Context {entry, proposal}.
